description: This file defines the JobStore class responsible for managing job lifecycle and file operations in a filesystem-based storage system. It includes methods for creating jobs, updating statuses, saving uploads, and cleaning up job data, with a focus on handling job-related metadata and file directories.

classes.name: JobPaths
classes.description: A dataclass representing file path structure for a specific job.

classes.name: JobStore
classes.description: Class providing filesystem-backed management of job lifecycle, status, and associated file operations.

methods.name: JobCreated create_job(self, initial_status: JobState = JobState.PENDING, message: Optional[str] = None)
methods.description: Creates a new job directory, writes initial metadata, and returns a JobCreated object.

methods.name: dict _read_meta(self, job_id: str)
methods.description: Reads and returns the job metadata from the meta.json file.

methods.name: None _write_meta(self, job_id: str, meta: dict)
methods.description: Writes updated metadata to the meta.json file.

methods.name: JobStatus update_status( self, job_id: str, *, status: Optional[JobState] = None, progress: Optional[int] = None, message: Optional[str] = None, result_url: Optional[str] = None, )
methods.description: Updates job status, progress, message, and result URL, then returns updated JobStatus.

methods.name: JobStatus save_error(self, job_id: str, error_message: str)
methods.description: Records an error message and sets the job state to ERROR.

methods.name: JobStatus get_status(self, job_id: str)
methods.description: Retrieves current status information of a specific job.

methods.name: None save_uploads(self, job_id: str, drawings_zip_path: Path, logo_image_path: Path)
methods.description: Saves a ZIP archive and logo image for a job, for backward compatibility.

methods.name: None save_uploads_flexible( self, job_id: str, logo_image_path: Path, drawings_zip_path: Optional[Path] = None, individual_files_dir: Optional[Path] = None, )
methods.description: Flexible upload handler supporting ZIP, individual files, and logo image uploads.

methods.name: Path get_uploads_dir(self, job_id: str)
methods.description: Returns the directory path for job uploads.

methods.name: Path get_work_dir(self, job_id: str)
methods.description: Returns the directory path for job work files.

methods.name: Path get_result_dir(self, job_id: str)
methods.description: Returns the directory path for job results.

methods.name: JobStatus set_result_url(self, job_id: str, result_url: str)
methods.description: Stores the result URL in the job metadata and returns updated status.

methods.name: None cleanup(self, job_id: str)
methods.description: Removes the entire job directory and associated files.
